info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Sale By Param1-spec
info.description: The Sales Retrieval API provides access to specific sale records based on given parameters. This endpoint allows users to query sales information linked to a specific identifier, ensuring that users can efficiently access detailed sale data. It is particularly useful for financial analysts and banking personnel who need to track and manage sales over time. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their sales management processes and overall operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve details for a specific party lifecycle management record.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch comprehensive details about a specific party identified by PARTY-600045 in the sales party lifecycle management system. It provides essential information that supports sales operations and party management activities.

requestBody.description: Detailed request body for retrieving information regarding the lifecycle of the specific party identified by PARTY-600045. It must conform to the defined schema in application/json format.

GetSaleByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body in JSON format for the operation related to party lifecycle management.

GetSaleByParam1Response_200.title: Party Lifecycle Management Response

productCode.description: Code representing the product associated with the prospect.

salesChannel.description: Channel through which the sale is made.

relationshipManagerId.description: Identifier for the relationship manager handling the prospect.

expectedValue.description: Expected financial value associated with the prospect.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the record was last updated.

metadata.description: Metadata associated with the response, including IDs and timestamps.

GetSaleByParam1Response_200.description: Response schema for retrieving party lifecycles, including details such as prospect ID, product information, and expected values.

ExpectedValue.title: Expected Value

amount.description: The monetary amount of the expected value.

currency.description: The currency in which the expected value is expressed.

ExpectedValue.description: Represents the expected financial value associated with a prospect.

Metadata.title: Response Metadata

correlationId.description: Identifier used for tracing through the system.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region where the response was processed.

Metadata.description: Metadata associated with the response including various identifiers and timestamps.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: The identifier for the endpoint that was called. This value can be used for tracking and logging purposes.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a Bearer authentication mechanism where the client must provide a JSON Web Token (JWT) in the Authorization header when making requests.
